title: de rien - you're welcome

checks.check: example sentence contains the target word
quiz has 3-4 unique options and exactly one valid correct answer
quiz correct option equals the taught meaning
reveal slide matches the quiz answer
reveal slide repeats the same word
audio transcript == subtitles (both generated from the same text)

uncertain: Dialogue, example sentence and notes were written by AI and have NOT been checked by a native French speaker.
Pronunciation hints are approximate English-style respellings (capitals = stressed syllable), not IPA, and were not machine-checked.
Level label A1 is a judgement call; there is no official CEFR word list.
notes: Automated checks only prove internal consistency. They cannot prove the French is natural or correct.
Pronunciation hints are approximate English-style respellings and were not machine-checked.

note: De rien is the everyday answer to merci.
Say it with a small shrug, as if it was nothing.
content.cta: Watch our latest Reel for more everyday French

api_limits: Stories are single-media: each slide is posted as its own Story.
The Instagram API cannot add stickers (poll, quiz, link, question) or captions to Stories.
The API has no native scheduling: this project's scheduled workflow publishes at publish_at.
manual_steps: Optional: post the quiz slide by hand in the Instagram app and add the native Quiz sticker (options from the quiz slide, correct answer set) instead of the text-reply version. Sticker taps are the strongest engagement signal on Stories.
Optional: add a Link sticker to the last Story by hand if you want a tappable link to the free lesson.
